integrity: The proof starts from the published DGM survival-discretization formula, derives an analytic small-rate expansion of the exact PMF log-concavity determinant, and supplies a replayable high-precision special case. The numerical certificate is supplementary rather than the basis of the infinite-family counterexample.
scientific_limitations: The result disproves universal DGM PMF log-concavity but does not give a complete parameter-space curvature classification.
The existence threshold for simultaneous log-convexity on a fixed finite prefix is not optimized.
The finding does not reassess the source's separate inference or data-fitting results.
title: Small-rate log-convexity disproves universal DGM PMF log-concavity
